items.requirement: An isoSPI (isolated SPI) transceiver pair or a digital isolator between the ADBMS1818ASWAZ-RL and the measurement coprocessor's SPI1, rated 85 V DC working or more (V189). Answered under Raised by P1: V289: A digital isolator on direct SPI, rated 85 V DC working or more (V189). Its pack side runs from the ADBMS1818's 5 V regulator output; its current is for research (owner, 2026-10-01)

items.function: Converter for the accelerometer; optical index
items.requirement: Delay variation at most 1.244 µs at 1,092 Hz (65,535 rpm): the optical index's share of V225. None of the 9 reflective sensors round 1 searched meets it; they state 10 to 70 µs. R10 is read for its share of the same budget. Answered under Raised by P1: V290: 52 ns at 65,535 rpm: V225's 2.54 µs less 1.244 µs each for the accelerometer and the optical index; the same split of 16.7 µs at 10,000 rpm gives 342 ns. It holds the ADCS7476's 30 ps aperture jitter and the chip-select trigger's jitter; PIO or a timer of the measurement coprocessor drives the trigger (owner, 2026-10-01) V291: No bus contention: the two ADCS7476 have the measurement coprocessor's SPI0 to themselves (Pins.md). The trigger and timer jitter sits inside V290's 52 ns (owner, 2026-10-01)
